Methodology

How We Compared BTC to HNT Exchange Services

We reviewed services that support Bitcoin and Helium on November 5, 2026 and confirmed a direct BTC-to-HNT route where stated in the ranking. Every service was assessed using the same seven criteria. We prioritized the complete user journey rather than selecting a winner from a single headline fee or marketing claim.

Live crypto quotes change from minute to minute. A fair price check uses the same BTC input, the same rate type and a narrow time window. Because a static quote would become outdated quickly, this page explains how to repeat the comparison immediately before exchanging.

How to compare live quotes yourself

  1. Open each service within the same 10–15 minute window.
  2. Enter the same BTC amount on every service.
  3. Select the same rate type where possible.
  4. Record the estimated HNT output before sending funds.
  5. Check whether network and service costs are already included.
  6. Compare the live minimum and expected completion conditions.
  7. Recheck the wallet address and final estimate before choosing a provider.

Limitations

Our review used publicly available service information and route-level forms. We did not send a real deposit through every provider. A displayed estimate is not the same as a completed-transaction result, particularly in floating-rate mode.

Step by step

How to Exchange Bitcoin for Helium on ChangeNOW

The standard BTC-to-HNT flow has three main exchange stages, plus a final address, network and amount check before you start. You need a Bitcoin wallet with enough BTC for the deposit and a wallet that supports HNT on Solana. The reviewed ChangeNOW pair page labels the destination as “HNT (SOLANA).” Confirm the network again before every exchange and use a Solana address, not an old Helium L1 address.

  1. 1

    Select Bitcoin and Helium

    Open the BTC-to-HNT exchange page. Choose Bitcoin as the asset you send and Helium as the asset you receive. Enter the BTC amount. The form will display the live minimum, HNT payout network and estimated output. Do not continue until the selected network matches your receiving wallet.

  2. 2

    Choose a rate mode

    Use floating mode if you want the exchange to follow current market conditions. Choose fixed mode when it is available and receiving the agreed amount matters more than tracking short-term market movement. Read the conditions shown in the live form.

  3. 3

    Enter a Solana address that supports HNT

    Paste the destination address from a wallet that supports HNT on Solana. Compare the first and last characters with the original address. Do not enter a Bitcoin address, an Ethereum 0x address or a legacy address from the former Helium L1. If you have an old Helium wallet, complete the official migration process before using it to receive current HNT.

  4. 4

    Review, send BTC and track the exchange

    Confirm the pair, amount, rate mode, HNT network and receiving address. Send the required Bitcoin amount to the generated BTC deposit address. Keep the exchange ID and follow the status until the HNT payout reaches your wallet on the selected network.

Important: A crypto exchange cannot normally be cancelled after you send the deposit. Blockchain transfers are irreversible, so verify the asset, network and address before sending BTC. HNT sent to an incompatible network or address may be permanently lost.

Start BTC to HNT Exchange

Two networks

What Changes When You Exchange BTC for HNT?

BTC is the native asset of the Bitcoin network. HNT is the native cryptocurrency and protocol token of the Helium Network, and it now operates as a token on Solana. Exchanging BTC for HNT is a cross-chain exchange: the service receives BTC on Bitcoin and sends HNT to the Solana address supplied by the user.

Why is HNT on Solana?

The Helium Network migrated from its purpose-built blockchain to Solana on April 18, 2023. Current HNT is therefore received and transferred on Solana. The official HNT mint address published by Helium is hntyVP6YFm1Hg25TN9WGLqM12b8TQmcknKrdu1oxWux. This is an informational reference only: copy your receiving address from your own supported wallet rather than interacting with a token contract manually. See the official Helium HNT documentation.

This operation is an exchange, not a native Bitcoin transfer and not a bridge that converts BTC into a wrapped version of Bitcoin. ChangeNOW receives BTC on the Bitcoin network and sends a separate HNT payout on Solana. Never send HNT to a Bitcoin address, Ethereum 0x address or unmigrated legacy Helium L1 address.

What should owners of an old Helium wallet do?

Wallets created before the Solana migration may need to be migrated or seeded using Helium’s official L1 migration tools. This page does not provide its own migration instructions: follow the official Helium L1 migration documentation and finish the migration before entering a receiving address in an exchange form.

Rates and timing

BTC to HNT Rates, Fees and Exchange Time

1

Exchange rate

The BTC-to-HNT rate shows how much Helium you can receive for a given amount of Bitcoin. It changes with market prices, liquidity and the selected rate mode.

2

Included costs

ChangeNOW states that all costs are built into the estimate shown before the swap, with no additional charge added after the exchange. Compare final HNT output rather than a headline fee alone.

3

Processing time

ChangeNOW publishes an overall average exchange time of about one minute, but a BTC-to-HNT swap can take longer because it starts after the required Bitcoin confirmations and depends on network and liquidity conditions.

Fixed rate or floating rate?

A floating rate follows the market while the exchange is processed, so the final HNT amount can differ from the initial estimate. A fixed rate is designed to preserve the agreed output when the exchange conditions are met. Fixed mode may use a different estimate because the provider takes on short-term rate risk.

Choose based on your priority: potential market movement in floating mode or greater output certainty in fixed mode. Always read the live terms before sending BTC.

Is there a minimum or maximum amount?

The live minimum changes with the pair, network costs and liquidity. ChangeNOW says minimum amounts can be as low as the equivalent of $2, but the BTC-to-HNT form is the authoritative source for the current transaction. ChangeNOW does not publish an upper limit for standard crypto-to-crypto swaps.

Stay safe

BTC to HNT Safety Checklist

Complete these checks before sending Bitcoin. Most address and network mistakes cannot be reversed.

  • Confirm that BTC is the deposit asset and HNT is the payout asset.
  • Confirm the exact HNT payout network shown in the live exchange form.
  • Use a wallet that supports HNT on that exact network and that you control.
  • Confirm that the form shows HNT on Solana.
  • Use a Solana address from a wallet that can display HNT; do not use a Bitcoin, Ethereum or legacy Helium L1 address.
  • Keep a small amount of SOL available if the receiving wallet will later need to send HNT or interact on Solana.
  • Copy the receiving address instead of typing it manually.
  • Compare the first and last characters after pasting the address.
  • Review the live minimum and estimated HNT output.
  • Check whether you selected a fixed or floating rate.
  • Send exactly the amount requested by the exchange form.
  • Save the exchange ID until the HNT payout arrives.
  • Consider a smaller test exchange when the transaction size justifies it.
  • Contact support through the service’s official domain only.

Never send funds based on an address received through an unsolicited message, social-media reply or search advertisement. Start from the official exchange page and verify the domain.
